violated_contract: Recent offline recordings from released clients without server capture proof must have a bounded path to fresh processing rather than joining the entire historical recovery backlog. Client timestamps must never authorize unbounded fresh capacity.
canonical_prevention: Keep provenance classification distinct from recency. Promote recent LEGACY uploads only behind an explicit flag and an atomic per-user upload-count and byte budget. Demote budget exhaustion and store failure to isolated backfill, preserving invalid, future and lookback handling and persisted worker lane.
